rules.reason: A media or CAD file type joined to a policy or occupation phrase finds almost nothing and spends a rate-limited request; those topics meet data, schema and API formats instead.
A query names a language once, by its own name or by its English name, never both.
Harness instruction files are rarely about a place; a country word excludes most of them.

provenance: Owner direction of October 5, 2026: a long string multiplication of topics, times, geographies and languages.
Started from the reviewed research query planner of October 1 (commit bc29e8e1): its normalisation, sensitive-term screen and plan binding are reused.
Dimension sources and licences are recorded per dimension; tables outside the repository are named by a declared data root and pinned by SHA-256.
